item.title: About Us
item.description: The MG Owners Club is the World's largest single marque car club. Formed in 1973 and supplying all MG requirements, the Club provides a full range of benefits for the dedicated MG enthusiast or the less enthusiastic owner who simply enjoys running an MG for everyday transport or just for fun. Catering for all types of MG but with the emphasis on 1950's models through to the present day, we offer an unrivalled range of benefits that actively encompass all the latest models. item.title: MG MOTOR UK AFFINITY SCHEME
item.description: We are delighted to announce a new partnership with MG Motor UK that offers current subscribing members of the MG Owners’ Club substantial discounts on a brand new MG. This covers the whole range of current models and the process for securing your new MG is very straightforward. How simple is MG Motor UK Affinity? Search for your new MG. See your Affinity savings Send your enquiry to your local MG main dealer All members need to do is set up an account on the MG Motor UK Affinity Scheme website

item.title: MG OWNERS' CLUB INSURANCE SCHEME
item.description: We are delighted to announce a brand new exclusive Members’ insurance scheme in partnership with Adrian Flux, which was officially launched at the NEC Practical Classics, Classic and Restoration Show at the end of March. Adrian Flux is the UK’s largest specialist motor insurance broker and is celebrating 50 years of serving the car owners’ needs of virtually every group of specialist vehicle, including sports cars, classic, vintage and modified to name a few.
